column1: # declared: its inputs are its lines in declared-<home>.tsv. covered: every repository read is already an input (its require closure,
# z-nile/ or scripts/ forcing, the place rule). fixture: it reads only files it wrote under .cache. literal: the search matched text only.
# A spec edited since its audit (another blob) is a hit again until it is re-read and a line for its new blob is added to the
# unsequestered declared/added-audited.tsv (this file is sequestered). Audit of 2026-11-03 on the tree at 86b77d4c (see E9).
# A spec may carry up to three lines: its blob today, the blob c0184's patch leaves and the blob c0165's own edit leaves.
# nohit: the E9 search does not hit the spec, so it is named by path only (blob field -); a spec file with no line at all fails AC14.
